She has not made any serious allegations against the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, even the medical records of the victim girl do not support the case NC:
2024:KHC:50941 of the prosecution.
Accordingly, he prays to allow this petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
7. The statement of the victim girl under Section 164 of Cr.P.C was recorded in the present case before the Jurisdictional Magistrate on 13.09.2024.
Victim girl has stated that she got acquainted with the petitioner in the year 2022, while she was studying in 1st year PUC.
Therefore, a serious doubt arises with regard to the age of the petitioner as on the date of the first information.
8. In the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, the victim girl has stated that she was in love with the petitioner and he had purchased a mobile phone and given the same to her.
She was talking to him over the said mobile phone and they used to meet each other frequently.
In the year 2022, when she was studying in PUC, he had taken her along with him to his room.

After NC:
2024:KHC:50941 completing her 2nd year PUC, she tried to speak to the petitioner during their village festival, but he did not respond.
Therefore, they had quarreled with each other.
She has also stated that he allegedly threatened her that he will circulate their photos in the social media and after her mother saw their photographs, she had taken her to the police station.

The victim girl has not made any serious allegation against the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, which would prima-facie attract the charge sheet alleged offences against the petitioner.
The medical records of the victim girl would disclose that the Doctor who had medically examined her has stated that there are no signs/evidences suggestive of recent sexual intercourse.
9. Petitioner aged about 22 years having no other criminal antecedents is in custody since 09.09.2024.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the view that, without expressing any NC: 2024:KHC:50941 opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail needs to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:-
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
